artworks.title: Phaethon's Sisters Become Poplars and His Friend a Swan
artworks.description: Rijksmuseum Ovid print: beside the Heliades turning to poplars, Phaethon's friend becomes a swan — Cycnus of Liguria, Ovid's mourner who shuns the sky that killed his companion.

artworks.title: The Sisters of Phaethon Transformed into Poplars
artworks.description: French print of the Eridanus mourning: the bank where Cycnus weeps among the new poplars before Phoebus remakes him as a swan — not Cycnus the warrior son of Ares, nor every mute swan of the genus.
